d: A legislator from actor-turned-politician Vijay's Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK) has been arrested in Tamil Nadu following allegations of sexual harassment and inappropriate messages made by a woman District Collector. MLA C. Arul Vignesh, representing Kallakurichi, was arrested on November 27 after the woman officer filed a complaint on November 23. The case reached the Madras High Court, which raised questions over the police investigation and directed that it be monitored by senior officers. Tamil Nadu Chief Minister M.K.
